name: acme
description: A fully rebranded deployment: a different name, publisher, description, URL scheme, server and tile set, sharing nothing with Astrid. The counterpart to astrid-web's acme.brand.json, and it exists for the same reason - a profile that merely loads is not a white-labelled build, so BrandProfileTests asserts that every value moves and that no Astrid value is left behind. Not a real partner; nothing here is deployed.
